name: Xuan Huong Lake
kicker: The lake in the middle of town
summary: Walk or pedal the shore of the lake in the middle of Da Lat, with pines on the bank and mist on the water early in the day. A loop takes 45 to 90 minutes and costs nothing. Come back after dark, when the path stays lit.
getThere: In the centre of Da Lat
heroCaption: Xuan Huong Lake and the pines along the bank
body: The shore path is the easy hour in Da Lat. Walk or jog the bank, or rent a pedal boat, and stop when you want tea. Pines and the town edge sit on the water.

A loop takes 45 to 90 minutes. Late afternoon has the best light, and a layer helps from November to January. The waterfalls and Lang Biang are half-day rides out, so do not treat the lake as the whole trip.

figures.caption: Xuan Huong Lake at dusk
figures.alt: Xuan Huong Lake in the evening, with the far bank still visible

gettingThere: The lake is the centre of town. Hotels around the shore walk straight out onto the path.

legs.heading: From the market slope
legs.body: Walk down to the water. The market is the uphill neighbour.

admissionNote: Free to walk (Visit Lâm Đồng). Pedal-boat hire is Check on arrival.
